Correction Feedback

Dr. Helen Wu
South Melbourne Rehabilitation Services
123 Emerald Street
South Melbourne
3205

20/01/2007

Dear Doctor,

Re: Mr. Jack Wojovski, aged 43 years

Thank you for seeing Mr. Wojovski, who presented with persistent pain and inability to perform
light duties at work following a back injury. He would require adequate physiotherapy and
management of his condition.

Initially, on 28/12/2006, Mr. Wojovski presented complaining of painful lower back after lifting a
heavy object at work. The examination revealed localized pain in the fourth and fifth paralumbar
area, and the range of movement was limited. There was no signs of neurological involvement, and     Commented [t1]: were
he was advised to take a two-day rest and was given analgesics.

Five days later, the pain has exacerbated, affecting Mr. Wojovski’s ability to bend or drive.
Physiotherapy was arranged, and Naprosyn was prescribed, which significantly improved his
condition, allowing him to return to work on 12/01/2007. He was advised to perform light duties.

On 17/01/2007, Mr. Wojovski presented with worsened pain, temporarily relived by physiotherapy.      Commented [t2]: relieved (wrong spelling)
His ability to perform light duties was restricted, and there were no abnormalities on x-ray.

In light of the above, I would be grateful for your thoughts on how to manage Mr. Wojovski’s
condition. I would appreciate it if you could update me on his condition.

Yours sincerely,
Doctor
